top_signals.title: Ukraine’s deadly AI training platform for drone tech opens to UK companies
top_signals.summary: Ukraine opens wartime battlefield data to Britain through Avengers AI Labs, giving British companies access to data for AI drone development.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Crypto CEO accuses North Korea of stealing $387 million from Bitget platform
top_signals.summary: The CEO said the company has a User Protection Fund that has over $464 million and those funds will be used to cover the losses.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
